name: Talamanca (Spain)
description: Lozengy of white and dark green, with eighteen green pieces.
history: The flag was approved on 7 June 2006 and published in the Diari Oficial de la Generalitat de Catalunya no. 4663 of 27 June 2006; it is an oblong flag of 2:3 lozengy of white and eighteen dark green pieces, the lozengy argent and vert being the arms of the Talamanca family (arms approved 22 October 1993).

features.role: lozengy of white and eighteen dark green pieces
